name: India
climate: Tropical monsoon to alpine and desert
landscape: Himalaya, Indo-Gangetic Plain, Thar Desert, Deccan Plateau, Western and Eastern Ghats
crops: Rice, wheat, pulses, sugarcane, cotton, tea, spices, mango, banana
summary: The world's most populous country; monsoon rains supply most of its water and feed a farm sector employing nearly half the workforce.

summary: The largest producer of rice, wheat and vegetables; the Yellow and Yangtze rivers shaped its farming history.
